state:
**Goal `php-oracle-retired`, Stage 3 in progress.** Stages 1 and 2 are done. ADR 0274 (`docs/decisions/0274.md`) is the goal's record.

The error corpus is `tests/conformance/` alone (`error_corpus` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/conformance_coverage.rs`, `errorGaps` in `tools/nv/cmd/gaps.ts`), held by `the_error_corpus_is_the_conformance_tree_alone`.

Of the 44 `--ORACLE-DIVERGES--` cases, 22 now have a conformance case: every `arr-*` one, and `csv-*`, `db-connect-*`, `encoding-*` and `json-*`. Each new case under `tests/conformance/core/` copies the `--FILE--` and the frozen `--EXPECT--`, with every comment rewritten to state Novis's behaviour and no PHP comparison, and a file name that names no PHP function. All were checked with the pipeline's `nvs test`. No duplicate check against existing conformance cases was done beyond `arr-fill-*`: porting every one is cheap and leaves no row unpinned.

Frozen records that still name a differential case in prose (`docs/decisions/0023.md:261`, `docs/adr/README.md:148`, parts of `0144.md` and `0211.md`) are left as they are, but `bun nv verify --doc` may flag them once Stage 4 deletes the tree (*not checked*).

items.text: **The rest of the divergences, `math-*` to `validate-*`, and the one `lang` case** — goal prose § *Stage 3*, second bullet. Start at `tests/differential/core/math-min-and-max-diverge-from-php-over-a-tie-a-numeral-string-or-an-unordered-pair.nvst:1` and go alphabetically through `path-*`, `regex-*`, `str-*`, `task-*`, `time-*` and `validate-*`, then `tests/differential/lang/a-negative-integer-exponent-refuses-where-php-answers-a-float.nvst:1` into `tests/conformance/lang/`. For each, copy the `--FILE--` and the `--EXPECT--` into a new case, rewrite every comment to say what Novis does (no PHP), name the file after the behaviour, and run `target/covws/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/debug/nvs.exe test <files>`. Copy the `--EXPECT--` with a tool, never by retyping: a retyped 128-byte band line came out one byte long. Commit one batch at a time.

backlog: Stage 4 starts once every divergence is pinned: delete `tests/differential/`, the `--ORACLE--` sections and `nvs test --php` — goal prose § *Stage 4*.
Frozen records naming a differential case in prose may trip `bun nv verify --doc` after Stage 4 — goal prose § *Standing decisions*, frozen records.
